verdict.rationale: Elastic's docs say users can query metrics with ES|QL or PromQL, visualize them, and use prebuilt dashboards, so a dashboard and visualization capability exists. Nothing describes building custom dashboards, sharing them, the range of visualization types, or template variables. Missing for 10: documented custom dashboard building, dashboard sharing, a catalog of rich visualization types, template/dashboard variables, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can build shareable dashboards with rich visualization types and template variables

citations.quote: Query them with ES|QL or Prometheus Query Language (PromQL), visualize them
